attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as the router between lan-a (trusted, node2) and lan-b (guest, node3): created UCI network interfaces lana (eth1, 192.168.10.1/24) and lanb (eth2, 192.168.20.1/24), and firewall zones lana (input/output/forward=ACCEPT) and lanb (input/output=ACCEPT, forward=REJECT) with an explicit lana->lanb forwarding rule. Assigned static IPs and cross-subnet routes on node2/node3 via NetworkManager. Verified guests can reach node1's own services (DNS) and are rejected when opening new connections to lan-a, while trusted hosts have full forwarded access to lan-b. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on node1, node2, and node3, confirming changed boot IDs and full functional recovery (config persistence, connectivity, isolation) after each restart.
